the measurement of the mass flow rate of refrigerant through each component of a system while the system is operating in a transient condition.

the development and testing of a system that measures mass rate of flow of refrigerant in the compressor and the change in the mass of each component in the system as a result of the operation of a heat pump in the transient mode.
